def initialControl (nodes edges mass count : Nat) : Nat :=
  max (max nodes edges) (max mass (count * mass))

def collectFuel (nodes edges mass count : Nat) : Nat :=
  HeightOrderControlled.majorant g (mass + 1) (initialControl nodes edges mass count)

theorem control_complete (limit control : Nat) (before : Config Symbol Guard)
    (good : Good limit before) (fits : Fits control before) :
    ∃ count rows after,
      Run count before rows after ∧ count ≤ fuel limit control ∧ Good limit after ∧
      Fits (fuel limit control) after ∧ after.pending = [] ∧
      collect (fuel limit control) before.heap before.seen before.pending = .done rows after.heap ∧
      ∀ extra, collect (fuel limit control + extra) before.heap before.seen before.pending = .done rows after.heap := by

theorem collect_complete (heap : State Symbol Guard) (seen : List Nat) (pending : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (mass : Nat) (semantic : SemanticHeap heap) (covered : Covered [] heap)
    (depth : InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap heap) (available : Values heap pending) (closed : ClosedValues pending)
    (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored mass heap) :
    ∃ count rows after,
      Run count ⟨heap, seen, pending⟩ rows after ∧
      count ≤ collectFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass pending.length ∧ Good mass after ∧
      Fits (collectFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass pending.length) after ∧ after.pending = [] ∧
      collect (collectFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass pending.length) heap seen pending = .done rows after.heap ∧
      ∀ extra, collect (collectFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass pending.length + extra) heap seen pending = .done rows after.heap := by

theorem complete_bound (value : Value Symbol Guard) (heap : State Symbol Guard) (mass : Nat)
    (semantic : SemanticHeap heap) (covered : Covered [] heap) (depth : InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap heap)
    (available : Available heap value) (closed : value.free = []) (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored mass heap) :
    ∃ rows after,
      nodeEdges (readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass) value heap = .done rows after ∧
      InternedValueMassHeap.Stored (readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass) after ∧
      after.nodes.next ≤ readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass ∧
      after.edges.next ≤ readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass := by

theorem complete (value : Value Symbol Guard) (heap : State Symbol Guard) (mass : Nat)
    (semantic : SourceEqualityRequiredSemanticCache.SemanticReady heap)
    (available : Available heap value) (closed : value.free = []) (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored mass heap) :
    ∃ rows after,
      nodeEdges (readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass) value heap = .done rows after ∧
      SourceEqualityProjectionRead.Read value heap rows after ∧
      SourceEqualityRequiredCache.Keeps heap after ∧ SourceEqualityRequiredSemanticCache.SemanticReady after ∧
      InternedValueMassHeap.Stored (readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass) after ∧
      after.nodes.next ≤ readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass ∧
      after.edges.next ≤ readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass ∧
      Edges after rows ∧ MergedColdReaderClosedInputs.ClosedEdges rows ∧
      ∀ extra, nodeEdges (readFuel heap.nodes.next heap.edges.next mass + extra) value heap = .done rows after := by
def g (bound : Nat) : Nat := bound + charge bound + ceiling bound + 1

theorem Step.good [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] {limit : Nat} {before after : Config Symbol Guard}
    (step : Step before after) (good : Good limit before) : Good limit after := by

theorem Step.fits [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] {limit bound : Nat} {before after : Config Symbol Guard}
    (step : Step before after) (good : Good limit before) (fits : Fits bound before) : Fits (g bound) after := by

inductive Run [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] :
    Nat → Config Symbol Guard → List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard) → Config Symbol Guard → Prop where
  /-- An empty pending list succeeds without a successor. -/
  | nil (heap : State Symbol Guard) (seen : List Nat) :
      Run 0 ⟨heap, seen, []⟩ [] ⟨heap, seen, []⟩
  /-- An actual successor emits its rows before the remaining successful run. -/
  | step (actual : SourceCurrentAllocatedReaderControl.Step before middle) (tail : Run count middle rows after) :
      Run (count + 1) before (emitted before ++ rows) after

/-- Every completed run retains its exact underlying successor path. -/

theorem extract [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    (fuel : Nat) (heap : State Symbol Guard) (seen : List Nat) (pending : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (rows : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (after : State Symbol Guard)
    (done : collect fuel heap seen pending = .done rows after) :
    ∃ count finalSeen, count ≤ fuel ∧ Run count ⟨heap, seen, pending⟩ rows ⟨after, finalSeen, []⟩ := by

def majorant (control : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, value => value
  | dimension + 1, value =>
      iterate (fun current => control (majorant control dimension current)) (value + 1) value

theorem stored_bounded (heap : State Symbol Guard) (bound : Nat) (stored : InternedValueMassHeap.Stored bound heap) :
    InternedMuDepthInventory.Bounded heap bound := by

def Settled [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (state : State Symbol Guard) (value : Value Symbol Guard) : Prop :=
  ∃ result, InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value state = .done result state

def count [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (state : State Symbol Guard) (degree : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range state.nodes.next).countP (unfinishedAt state degree)

def Progress [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (limit : Nat) (before after : State Symbol Guard) : Prop :=
  HeightOrder.VectorBelow limit (fun index => count after index) (fun index => count before index) ∨ after = before

theorem unfold_progress [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (limit : Nat) (value : Value Symbol Guard)
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SourceRecursiveIntersectionSemanticHeap.SemanticHeap before)
    (covered : Covered [] before) (heap : InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap before) (bounded : Bounded before limit)
    (available : Available before value) (closed : value.free = []) (result : Value Symbol Guard) (after : State Symbol Guard)
    (done : InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value before = .done result after) :
    Progress limit before after := by

theorem collect_progress [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (fuel limit : Nat)
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SemanticHeap before) (covered : Covered [] before)
    (heap : InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap before) (bounded : Bounded before limit)
    (seen : List Nat) (pending : List (Value Symbol Guard)) (inputs : Values before pending) (closed : ClosedValues pending)
    (edges : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (after : State Symbol Guard)
    (done : collect fuel before seen pending = .done edges after) :
    InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap after ∧ Bounded after limit ∧ Progress limit before after := by

theorem nodeEdges_progress [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (fuel limit : Nat)
    (value : Value Symbol Guard) (before : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SemanticHeap before) (covered : Covered [] before)
    (heap : InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap before) (bounded : Bounded before limit)
    (available : Available before value) (closed : value.free = []) (edges : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard))
    (after : State Symbol Guard) (done : nodeEdges fuel value before = .done edges after) :
    InternedOpenDepthReadback.Heap after ∧ Bounded after limit ∧ Progress limit before after := by

def allRows [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] [DecidableEq Symbol] (fuel : Nat) (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (compare : Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool)
    (wide : Value Symbol Guard) : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard) → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool
  | [], state => .done true state
  | narrow :: rest, state =>
      (MergedFreshOrdinaryExposure.read fuel wide state).bind fun wides afterRead =>
        (anyCover clear compare narrow wides afterRead).bind fun accepted after =>
          if accepted then allRows fuel clear compare wide rest after else .done false after

def check [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] [DecidableEq Symbol] (clear : Guard → Bool) :
    Nat → List (Nat × Nat) → Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool
  | fuel, above, wide, narrow, state =>
      if narrow.referenceOf = .empty then .done true state
      else if wide.referenceOf = .empty then .done false state
      else if wide.referenceOf = narrow.referenceOf then .done true state
      else match identity wide, identity narrow with
        | none, _ => .failed (.identity wide.referenceOf) state
        | _, none => .failed (.identity narrow.referenceOf) state
        | some wideId, some narrowId =>
            if (wideId, narrowId) ∈ above then .done true state
            else match fuel with
              | 0 => .failed .exhausted state
              | fuel + 1 =>
                  (MergedFreshOrdinaryExposure.read (fuel + 1) narrow state).bind fun narrows after =>
                    allRows (fuel + 1) clear (check clear fuel ((wideId, narrowId) :: above)) wide narrows after

def identity : Value Symbol Guard → Option Nat
  | .node entry .. | .union entry .. | .mu entry .. => some entry.identity
  | .reference (.interned identity) => some identity
  | _ => none

def children (compare : Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool) :
    List (Value Symbol Guard) → List (Value Symbol Guard) → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool
  | [], _, state | _, [], state => .done true state
  | wide :: wides, narrow :: narrows, state =>
      (compare wide narrow state).bind fun accepted after =>
        if accepted then children compare wides narrows after else .done false after

def anyCover [DecidableEq Symbol] (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (compare : Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool)
    (narrow : EdgeValue Symbol Guard) : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard) → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool
  | [], state => .done false state
  | wide :: rest, state =>
      if wide.entry.key.symbol = narrow.entry.key.symbol ∧ wide.children.length = narrow.children.length ∧ clear wide.entry.key.constraint = true then
        (children compare wide.children narrow.children state).bind fun accepted after =>
          if accepted then .done true after else anyCover clear compare narrow rest after
      else anyCover clear compare narrow rest state

def CompleteCallback (limit : Nat) (before : State Symbol Guard)
    (compare : Nat → Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ wide narrow state, SemanticReady state → Bounded state limit → Available state wide → Available state narrow →
    wide.free = [] → narrow.free = [] → Budget limit before state → EventuallyDone (fun fuel => compare fuel wide narrow state)

theorem children_eventually (limit : Nat) (before : State Symbol Guard)
    (compare : Nat → Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool)
    (callbacks : ∀ fuel, Callback limit (compare fuel)) (complete : CompleteCallback limit before compare)
    (wides narrows : List (Value Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SemanticReady state) (bounded : Bounded state limit)
    (wideInputs : Values state wides) (narrowInputs : Values state narrows) (wideClosed : ClosedValues wides) (narrowClosed : ClosedValues narrows)
    (reached : Budget limit before state) : EventuallyDone (fun fuel => children (compare fuel) wides narrows state) := by

theorem anyCover_eventually [DecidableEq Symbol] (limit : Nat) (before : State Symbol Guard) (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (compare : Nat → Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool)
    (callbacks : ∀ fuel, Callback limit (compare fuel)) (complete : CompleteCallback limit before compare)
    (narrow : EdgeValue Symbol Guard) (wides : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard)
    (semantic : SemanticReady state) (bounded : Bounded state limit)
    (narrowInput : Values state narrow.children) (wideInputs : Edges state wides)
    (narrowClosed : ClosedValues narrow.children) (wideClosed : ClosedEdges wides) (reached : Budget limit before state) :
    EventuallyDone (fun fuel => anyCover clear (compare fuel) narrow wides state) := by

theorem allRows_eventually [DecidableEq Symbol] (limit : Nat) (before : State Symbol Guard) (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (compare : Nat → Value Symbol Guard → Value Symbol Guard → State Symbol Guard → Result Symbol Guard Bool)
    (callbacks : ∀ fuel, Callback limit (compare fuel)) (complete : CompleteCallback limit before compare)
    (wide : Value Symbol Guard) (narrows : List (EdgeValue Symbol Guard)) (state : State Symbol Guard)
    (semantic : SemanticReady state) (bounded : Bounded state limit)
    (wideInput : Available state wide) (narrowInputs : Edges state narrows) (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : ClosedEdges narrows)
    (reached : Budget limit before state) : EventuallyDone (fun fuel => allRows (fuel + 1) clear (compare fuel) wide narrows state) := by

theorem check_eventually [DecidableEq Symbol] (limit : Nat) (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SemanticReady state) (bounded : Bounded state limit)
    (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard)
    (wideInput : Available state wide) (narrowInput : Available state narrow) (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : narrow.free = []) :
    EventuallyDone (fun fuel => check clear fuel above wide narrow state) := by

theorem check_complete [DecidableEq Symbol] (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (semantic : SemanticReady state) (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard)
    (wideInput : Available state wide) (narrowInput : Available state narrow) (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : narrow.free = []) :
    ∃ bound accepted after, (∀ fuel, bound ≤ fuel → check clear fuel above wide narrow state = .done accepted after) ∧ Effect state after := by

theorem identity_closed (value : Value Symbol Guard) (state : State Symbol Guard)
    (facts : Facts state) (available : Available state value) (closed : value.free = [])
    (nonempty : value.referenceOf ≠ .empty) :
    ∃ number, identity value = some number ∧ number < state.nodes.next := by

theorem remaining_cons_lt (limit : Nat) (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (pair : Nat × Nat)
    (member : pair ∈ remainingPairs limit above) :
    (remainingPairs limit (pair :: above)).length < (remainingPairs limit above).length := by

structure Budget (limit : Nat) (before after : State Symbol Guard) : Prop where
  effect : Effect before after
  bounded : Bounded after limit
  progress : Progress limit before after

/-- Ordered successful stages compose degree progress through their actual cache. -/

theorem check_budget [DecidableEq Symbol] (limit : Nat) (clear : Guard → Bool)
    (fuel : Nat) (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard) (before : State Symbol Guard)
    (semantic : SemanticReady before) (bounded : Bounded before limit)
    (wideInput : Available before wide) (narrowInput : Available before narrow) (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : narrow.free = [])
    (answer : Bool) (after : State Symbol Guard) (done : check clear fuel above wide narrow before = .done answer after) : Budget limit before after := by

def comparisonBound : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, bound => bound
  | fuel + 1, bound => iterate (rowBound (fuel + 1) (comparisonBound fuel))
      (readWidth (fuel + 1) bound) (readBound (fuel + 1) bound)

theorem check_bound [DecidableEq Symbol] [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (clear : Guard → Bool) (fuel : Nat) (above : List (Nat × Nat))
    (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard) (before : State Symbol Guard) (bound : Nat)
    (semantic : SemanticReady before) (stored : Stored bound before)
    (wideInput : Available before wide) (narrowInput : Available before narrow)
    (wideClosed : wide.free = []) (narrowClosed : narrow.free = [])
    (answer : Bool) (after : State Symbol Guard) (done : check clear fuel above wide narrow before = .done answer after) :
    Resources (comparisonBound fuel bound) before after :=

theorem check_stable [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] [DecidableEq Symbol]
    (clear : Guard → Bool) (fuel extra : Nat) (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (value : Bool) (after : State Symbol Guard)
    (done : check clear fuel above wide narrow state = .done value after) :
    check clear (fuel + extra) above wide narrow state = check clear fuel above wide narrow state :=

theorem successful_results_eq [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] [DecidableEq Symbol]
    (clear : Guard → Bool) (first second : Nat) (above : List (Nat × Nat)) (wide narrow : Value Symbol Guard)
    (state : State Symbol Guard) (left right : Bool) (after final : State Symbol Guard)
    (firstDone : check clear first above wide narrow state = .done left after)
    (secondDone : check clear second above wide narrow state = .done right final) :
    (left, after) = (right, final) := by

theorem select_complete (clear : Guard → Bool) (inputs : List (Value Symbol Guard))
    (before : State Symbol Guard) (bound : Nat) (semantic : SemanticReady before) (stored : Stored bound before)
    (available : Values before inputs) (closed : ClosedValues inputs) :
    ∃ fuel result after, select clear fuel inputs before = .done result after ∧
      Resources (selectionBound fuel inputs.length bound) before after := by

theorem unfold_bound [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)] (value : Value Symbol Guard) (before : State Symbol Guard) (bound : Nat)
    (stored : Stored bound before) (available : Available before value) :
    Stored (ceiling bound) (InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value before).state ∧
      (InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value before).state.nodes.next ≤ before.nodes.next + charge bound ∧
      (InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value before).state.edges.next ≤ before.edges.next + charge bound ∧
      ∀ result after, InternedFreshOrdinaryStoredSubstitution.unfold value before = .done result after →
        InternedValueMass.value result ≤ ceiling bound := by

def NodeClosed (path : List Int) (value : Value Symbol Guard) : Prop :=
  match path, value with
  | [], value => value.free = []
  | _ :: _, .empty => True
  | index :: path, .node _ edges _ _ =>
      ∀ edge ∈ edges, ∀ child, select edge.children index = some child → NodeClosed path child
  | _ :: _, value => value.free = []
termination_by path.length

def ForestClosed (path : List Int) (values : List (Value Symbol Guard)) : Prop :=
  match path with
  | [] => ClosedValues values
  | index :: path => ∀ value, select values index = some value → NodeClosed path value

theorem forest_effects [DecidableEq (EdgeKey Symbol Guard)]
    {path : List Int} {values : List (Value Symbol Guard)} {result : Value Symbol Guard} {before after : State Symbol Guard}
    (trace : Forest path values before result after) (semantic : SemanticReady before)
    (available : Values before values) (domain : ForestClosed path values) :
    Keeps before after ∧ SemanticReady after ∧ Available after result ∧ result.free = [] := by
